exposure: endometrial thickness on the day of human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) administration
outcome: clinical pregnancy outcome of in vitro fertilization/intracytoplasmic sperm injection (IVF/ICSI)
finding: The study identified several factors associated with IVF/ICSI failure in older women, including age ≥40 years, dysmenorrhea, history of cesarean section, low basal AFC, low number of high-quality embryos, and thin endometrial lining.
